regex: (?:^read, bash, edit, eval, glob, grep, task, wait, web_search, write(?:, yield)?$|^read, bash, edit, eval, glob, grep, wait, web_search, write(?:, yield)?$|^# Delegation$|^- Unfamiliar subsystem\? Explore it with a read-only `scout` while you keep working; read known files yourself\.$|^## Delegation gates$|^- Before spawning, map slices/shared contracts; user-enumerated 2\+ self-contained runnable slices exempt\. NEVER outsource top-level plan; slice design/competing plans allowed\.$|^- Fan genuine slices in one `tasks\[\]` batch\. NEVER pad, serialize independent work, or spawn then idle\.$|^- Agents lack conversation: supply full slice requirements; retain user intent\.$|^- Shared prerequisite inline; sequence ONLY true dependencies\. Small missing detail\? Run parallel; B asks A via `write agent://<id>` only if blocked\.$)
why: PiG CLI host does not bind createChildSession onto depth-1 child sessions (HostMaxRecursionDepth = 1), so depth-1 children omit `task` from Tool Inventory and the `# Delegation` section.

ref_term: `# Peers` status of a same-batch sibling
why: Inside `# Peers`, matches ONLY a paired `-`/`+` line for a `task (sub, ...)` sibling id of the same case where omp shows `idle` and oh-my-pig shows `running` (caused by omp's speculative batch launch finishing sibling 0 before sibling 1 builds its prompt under an instant scripted model); never matches Main, reversed statuses, mismatched ids, or reordered rosters.
PiG CLI host does not bind createChildSession onto depth-1 child sessions, so depth-1 children omit `task`.

regex: (?:^Session tool names: read, bash, edit, eval, glob, grep, task, wait, web_search, write, ast_edit, debug, lsp\.$|^Session tool names: read, bash, edit, eval, glob, grep, wait, web_search, write, ast_edit, debug, lsp\.$)
why: PiG CLI host caps subagent recursion at depth 1 (HostMaxRecursionDepth = 1), so depth-1 children omit `task` from the `eval` description's `Session tool names:` line.

regex: (?:^- :raw verbatim without anchors/prefixes \(skips folding and the display-width limit\); combine :2-4:raw or :raw:2-4 for exactly those lines\.$|^- :raw verbatim without anchors/prefixes \(skips the display-width limit\); combine :2-4:raw or :raw:2-4 for exactly those lines\.$|^- Bare code: declarations only; re-read ONLY footer-named omissions, NEVER guess `\.\.`/`…`\.$|^- PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/EPUB: extracted text; notebooks: editable cells; images: decoded inline\.$|^- Also, with selectors in help://read/sources \(read it before first use\):$|^  - SQLite, archives \(ZIP, TAR, 7z, RAR and more\), JSON/JSONL by jq filter, executable metadata, video, SVG as image, merge conflicts\.$|^- Notebooks \(\.ipynb\): cell text; images \(PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP\): decoded inline\.$|^- Archives \(ZIP, JAR, APK, WHL, TAR, TAR\.GZ, TGZ\): directory listing; member via archive\.ext:member/path\.$)
why: read.md intentionally omits unported sources (AST folding, PDF/DOCX/SQLite/7z/RAR/jq/video/SVG) to avoid promising unsupported selectors.

regex: ^- `tools`: eval-defined, run in your kernel\.$

regex: (?:^SHOULD `edit` existing files; `write` for required new files or whole-file replacement\. NEVER create docs or emojis unless requested\.$|^Archive members and SQLite rows are writable too: help://read/sources\.$)
why: Archive member and SQLite row writes are not ported, so write.md omits that line.

regex: (?:^  "text": "Attached image\(s\) from tool result:\\n\[image_url:data:image/webp;base64,b64_len=184\]"$|^  "text": "Attached image\(s\) from tool result:\\n\[image_url:data:image/png;base64,b64_len=92\]"$)
